title: Trump imposes new 12.5% tariff on Singapore, affecting one-third of exports to US
desc: SINGAPORE: About one-third of Singapore's domestic exports to the United States are now subject to a new 12.5 per cent tariff aimed at rebuilding US President Donald Trump's tariff regime after its legal basis was undermined by a court decision earlier in 2026.

title: Oriental Mindoro cops tighten security ahead of Marcos' Sona
desc: The Oriental Mindoro Police Provincial Office has heightened security measures across the province ahead of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s Sona.

title: Pakistan: Karachi rains disrupt power supply as over 200 feeders trip during first monsoon spell
desc: Karachi's first spell of the monsoon season triggered widespread power outages across the city after more than 200 feeders of Pakistan's K-Electric were affected by rain-related faults, with electricity supply disrupted in several neighbourhoods, The Express Tribune reported.

title: Female student held over baby's body found in hostel area
desc: SHAH ALAM: Police have arrested a female student in connection with the discovery of a baby's body wrapped in cloth at a waste collection area of a hostel block at a higher learning institution in Kuala Langat on Friday (July 24).

title: Sultan Mizan in good health, says Office of Sultan of Terengganu
desc: KUALA LUMPUR: The Sultan of Terengganu, Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin, is in good health and will continue his scheduled follow-up treatment abroad under the care of His Royal Highness' medical team.

title: Venus may be tearing itself apart from within
desc: Scientists have uncovered new evidence that Venus may still be tearing itself apart from within. Advanced 3D simulations indicate that some of the planet's giant rift valleys formed relatively recently and could still be expanding. The results suggest Venus has a far more active interior than researchers once believed, challenging the long-held view of a geologically dormant world.
